evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English.

Required application materials include: a completed online application form, a motivation statement, a writing sample, two academic letters of recommendation from teachers, official transcripts, and proof of advanced English proficiency for non-native English speakers.
The Admissions Committee will accept transcripts in English or German.
If you do not have transcripts in either of these languages, you must submit an official translation along with the original transcript.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states a fee for all countries of 19,125 EUR per semester; the Bard College Berlin page states annual comprehensive fees (38,250 EUR on-campus / 27,500 EUR off-campus) for all students in 2026-27; the annual on-campus figure is used. Application channel: the pages only describe applying via the Common Application or the Bard College Berlin application portal (there is no mention of uni-assist), so de-university-direct is used; no application fee is charged. Intakes: the only stated deadlines are for the 'Final Application Deadline' which applies to citizens and residents of a list of countries (Morocco is not named) and the EU/EEA deadline (1 September - 1 May); no deadline is clearly stated for a Moroccan applicant, so no intake is given. German B1 is required by the end of the second year; English C1 is required at admission, with IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL iBT 95 named.

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme marocain (Baccalauréat) est reconnu équivalent à l'Abitur allemand sur Anabin; l'admission au diplôme américain est possible sans équivalence.
note.en: Check whether your Moroccan Baccalauréat is recognised as equivalent to the German Abitur on Anabin; admission to the American degree is possible without equivalence.

evidence.quote: To be eligible for the German BA degree, students must have a secondary school qualification that is considered equivalent to the German Abitur.

note.fr: Le dossier peut inclure un entretien: après un premier examen, certains candidats sont invités à un entretien en ligne d'environ 30 minutes.
note.en: The application process may include an interview: after an initial review, selected applicants are invited to a 30-minute online interview.

evidence.quote: After an initial review of your application, selected applicants will receive an invitation to schedule an interview.

note.fr: Fournissez votre relevé de notes officiel via votre établissement (pas vous-même); une traduction officielle est requise si le document n'est pas en anglais ou en allemand.
note.en: Have your official transcript sent by your school (not yourself); an official translation is required if the document is not in English or German.

evidence.quote: Please have your high school transcript submitted by your high school counselor, teacher, or principal.

note.fr: La demande d'aide financière (formulaire et justificatifs) doit être soumise dans la semaine suivant la candidature, et au plus tard à la date limite.
note.en: The financial aid application (form and supporting documents) must be submitted within one week of applying, and no later than the application deadline.

evidence.quote: It is important that you complete this form and provide supporting documentation within one week of submitting your application for admission, and no later than the application deadline.
